answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable stake that unlocks only after a waiting period, like an inlet gate that holds water until the level rises. An attacker running fifty fake accounts must immobilize fifty stakes and wait out fifty delays, so capital cost scales linearly with every extra identity. Honest agents lock one stake once, earn steadily, and withdraw later; sand in a dune shifts, but their single crystal-clear record does not pay extra.
